==Description==
The '''Developer 3''' was an [[Enemies|enemy]] that only appeared in the [[Hidden Wave (Legacy)|Hidden Wave]] and therefore only appeared in [[Fallen Mode|Fallen]] mode.

The '''Developer 3''' had a very high amount of health (higher than the [[Developer 2]]) and walked at a Slightly Fast pace. The '''Developer 3''' was spawned from the [[Creator]] and did not appear naturally in the [[Hidden Wave (Legacy)|Hidden Wave]].

==Appearance==
As with other developer [[enemies]] in the game, the '''Developer 3''' was a re-textured version of a developer of the game, more specifically, [https://www.roblox.com/users/29706395/profile Razuatix].

The '''Developer 3''' was faceless with grey skin, black granite torso, legs and sleeves. It had a black reflective tie, clockwork headphones, clockwork shades and a fedora. "0" and "1" particles could be seen emitting from its torso, representing binary.

==Strategy==
*As with most enemies in the [[Hidden Wave (Legacy)|Hidden Wave]], this enemy can be taken down with high DPS towers such as the {{Color|Golden}} [[Minigunner]], [[Turret]], [[Accelerator]] or [[Ranger]].
**The [[Commander]] helps greatly in defeating this enemy.
*This enemy can be slowed down by the [[Electroshocker]], [[Sledger]], [[Toxic Gunner]], [[Frost Blaster]] and [[Freezer]].
*As the '''Developer 3''' falls out of the map as it spawns, it cannot collide with [[units]]. However, [[units]] can detect it and damage it by other means.
**The [[Pyromancer]] can detect the '''Developer 3''' but cannot hit it.

==Trivia==
*This [[Enemies|enemy]] is similar to the [[Developer 1]] and [[Developer 2]].
**Like these enemies, the '''Developer 3''' did not appear naturally in the [[Hidden Wave (Legacy)|Hidden Wave]] and was instead spawned by the [[Creator]].
*This enemy's appearance is based on {{RLinkU|Razuatix}}, a former developer of the game.
*When '''Developer 3''' spawned, it fell out of the map. Therefore, the enemy model did not appear on the path.
